scope: PNG generation and visual review only; no learned policy or event qualification

visual_review.01_time_sea_control_reserve.png: Reviewed: SEA torque, normalized control, zero prosthetic reserves and overlays are legible; CASCADE outer gains match the completed run receipt and PI inner gains come from the current model.
visual_review.02_time_joint_motor_states.png: Reviewed: joint and motor angle/speed traces and startup transient are visible; knee flexion sign matches the canonical convention; legends and axes are legible.
visual_review.03_gaitcycle_torque_angle_power.png: Reviewed: torque-angle, joint/motor power and healthy mean/std overlays are legible; four measured-GRF reference cycles provide the phase alignment.
visual_review.04_gaitcycle_joint_velocity_power.png: Reviewed: prosthetic and healthy angle, velocity and power mean/std overlays are legible; phase axis is percent of the measured-GRF reference gait cycle.
visual_review.05_time_tau_input_tracking_error.png: Reviewed: motor torque and separate torque-tracking error panels are legible, including the startup transient; no missing-channel annotation.
visual_review.06_time_joint_ref_sea_error.png: Reviewed: radians and seconds are labelled, recorded served reference and actual motion are separated, and the tracking error remains visible on its own axes.
visual_review.07_prescribed_healthy_ik_actual.png: Reviewed: title explicitly identifies a V26 prescribed diagnostic without learned policy; current raw IK, healthy remap and actual traces are in degrees. The delayed actual peaks relative to raw IK are visible and distinct from the served-reference tracking in figure 06.

gait_cycle_alignment.meaning: Measured prescribed-GRF reference cycles used only for canonical phase plots; these are not V26 binary/actor-FSM events and do not establish online event qualification.
